title: Timbuktu gets a 4K restoration
body: Abderrahmane Sissako's 2014 Cannes standout Timbuktu has been remastered in 4K, giving new visibility to the first film by a Black African-born director nominated for the Best Foreign Language Oscar.

title: Whisper captioning project reaches its first milestone
body: Early tests of an open Whisper-based subtitle pipeline for archival African cinema have produced usable Wolof and Bambara transcripts, a first step toward wider-language access across the collection.

title: FESPACO 2027 dates announced
body: Ouagadougou's Pan-African Film and Television Festival has confirmed its next edition, keeping its place as the continent's longest-running showcase for African-directed cinema.

title: Arsenal Berlin digitizes another reel from its African cinema holdings
body: Arsenal Institute for Film and Video Art has added another newly digitized print from its African cinema holdings to its public access catalog, part of an ongoing preservation effort.
